fields.label: Send notifications to chat instead of email
fields.description: Reminders, mentions and escalations go to Slack or Microsoft Teams. Emails to customers are not affected.

fields.label: Email people who can't be reached in chat
fields.description: Slack: people whose email isn't in the workspace. Teams: used only when the webhook fails.

fields.label: Bot Token
fields.description: From your Slack app (OAuth & Permissions), starts with xoxb-. Scopes: chat:write, users:read, users:read.email.

fields.label: Escalation Channel ID
fields.description: Optional, e.g. C0123ABCD. Invite the app to the channel.

fields.label: Direct Message Workflow URL
fields.description: Teams Workflow "When a Teams webhook request is received" that posts the card to the chat of the email in `recipient`.

fields.label: Escalation Channel Workflow URL
fields.description: Optional. Teams Workflow template "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received".
